title: Skill Library
subtitle: A curated set of the most popular skills right now, grouped by use case. Tap a card for the full breakdown — the official site link lives inside each detail page.

skills.name: Remotion
skills.overview: Remotion lets you generate video by writing React components — the timeline, frames and audio are all code, and every frame is precisely controllable. It turns video production into programming, ideal for reusable, batch-generated video.
features: Describe video as React components, rendered frame by frame
Parametric rendering — one template, many video variants
Render locally or via Remotion's cloud render queue
useCases: Product demos and app intro clips
skills.bestFor: Developers comfortable with React who want video as a programmable asset.
skills.author: Remotion

skills.name: Runway
skills.overview: Runway is a creator-focused AI video tool: generate and edit video from text or images. Its Gen models do text-to-video and image-to-video, plus object removal and motion brush — great for fast turnarounds.
features: Text / image to video (Gen series models)
Smart object removal, outpainting, motion brush
Video-to-template, lip-sync and more creative tools
useCases: Quick prototypes for social clips and ad creatives
Turning still images into moving shots
Removing unwanted objects or filling missing frames
skills.bestFor: Designers and marketers who want AI video fast without editing skills.
skills.author: Runway

skills.name: HeyGen
skills.overview: HeyGen turns a script into a talking-head video with an AI avatar, with multilingual voiceover and avatar/voice cloning. Handy for training, marketing and multilingual content.
features: 120+ languages with translated voiceover and lip-sync
useCases: Alternative when live shooting is costly
skills.bestFor: Teams that need lots of presenter-style video without repeated filming.
skills.author: HeyGen

skills.name: Manim
skills.overview: Manim is a Python engine for scripted math and algorithm animations — the same one 3Blue1Brown uses. You describe how objects change and it renders precise animation, perfect for explainers and teaching.
features: Declare object transformations and animation in code
Rich geometry, functions and 3D scene support
Active community edition with many examples
skills.bestFor: Teachers and science communicators willing to code to make ideas clear.
skills.author: Manim Community

skills.name: MoviePy
skills.overview: MoviePy is a Python library for video editing — cut, concatenate, caption, transition and mix audio. Great for scripting and batching repetitive editing work.
features: Basic editing: cut, concat, speed, rotate
skills.bestFor: Python developers who'd rather script than manually edit.
skills.author: MoviePy

skills.name: Motion
skills.overview: Motion (formerly Framer Motion) is the most popular animation library in the React ecosystem. Its declarative API adds enter, layout, scroll and gesture animations with a low learning curve and a huge community.
features: Layout animation handles position changes automatically
useCases: Enter and interaction motion for pages / cards
State changes like lists and steppers
skills.bestFor: React product teams wanting smooth motion without hand-writing CSS.
skills.pricing: Open source (MIT, most commercial use OK); Pro adds paid extras
skills.author: Motion

skills.name: GSAP
skills.overview: GSAP is a long-standing professional web animation engine. A timeline precisely controls DOM, SVG and Canvas animation with great performance and compatibility — the go-to for complex motion and ad animation.
useCases: Complex motion on landing / brand sites
skills.bestFor: Professional front-end engineers demanding precision and compatibility.
skills.pricing: Free for personal / non-profit; commercial Standard subscription; some plugins paid
skills.author: GreenSock

skills.name: Lottie
skills.overview: Lottie exports animations designers make in AE into lightweight JSON that front-ends play natively with lottie-web — small, crisp and consistent across platforms. The standard design-to-animation pipeline.
features: Vector JSON animation: small and sharp
LottieFiles hosts a huge library of ready animations
useCases: Light decorative motion on marketing pages
skills.bestFor: Teams that need to ship design motion cheaply and faithfully.
skills.author: LottieFiles

skills.name: Rive
skills.overview: Rive lets designers and developers collaborate on interactive, stateful animation — buttons, characters and game elements respond in real time, with a cross-platform runtime. More interactive than Lottie.
features: Real-time response to input, no per-clip export
skills.bestFor: Teams wanting living, interactive animation rather than a played clip.
skills.author: Rive

skills.name: Buffer
skills.overview: Buffer is a long-standing social scheduling tool. Queue posts across X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and more from one calendar — good for individuals and small teams keeping a steady cadence.
features: Unified scheduling and calendar across platforms
Browser extension to save ideas on the fly
useCases: Daily posting cadence for a personal IP
skills.bestFor: Individuals and small businesses wanting steady, low-effort multi-platform posting.
skills.author: Buffer

skills.name: Typefully
skills.overview: Typefully focuses on the writing experience: draft X threads and newsletters smoothly, then schedule and publish in one click, with draft collaboration and basic analytics. A favorite among writers.
useCases: Splitting one long read into multiple tweets
skills.bestFor: Writers whose core is content and who grow through it.
skills.author: Typefully

skills.name: Hypefury
skills.overview: Hypefury is for people serious about Twitter growth: scheduled tweets, auto-retweets, and routing high-performing tweets to your email or product — turning followers into subscriptions and revenue.
features: Auto-route top tweets to a link
useCases: Steady output for a personal IP
skills.bestFor: Creators using Twitter to grow and monetize systematically.
skills.author: Hypefury

skills.name: Opus Clip
skills.overview: Opus Clip uses AI to cut long videos (podcasts, streams, courses) into multiple vertical shorts for TikTok / Reels / Shorts, with auto-captions and highlights — no manual editing.
skills.bestFor: People with long footage who want a low-cost short-video pipeline.
skills.author: Opus

skills.name: Repurpose.io
skills.overview: Repurpose.io auto-forwards what you post on TikTok / Reels / YouTube to other platforms. Set it up once and it keeps syncing — no manual re-upload.
skills.bestFor: People running multiple social accounts who fear missing a post.
skills.author: Repurpose.io

skills.name: Cursor
skills.overview: Cursor is a VS Code-based AI code editor that reads your whole codebase and edits, completes and refactors by conversation. One of the hottest AI coding tools right now.
features: Multi-file refactor and terminal command generation
useCases: Ramp up on an unfamiliar repo fast
skills.bestFor: Developers who want AI to actually write code.
skills.author: Cursor

skills.name: v0
skills.overview: v0 is Vercel's AI UI generator: describe what you want and get React + Tailwind components and pages, then refine by chat and export the code — great for fast prototypes.
useCases: Fast UI prototype from an idea
skills.bestFor: Front-end and product people who want to speak interfaces into being.
skills.author: Vercel

skills.name: Figma
skills.overview: Figma is a browser-based interface design and prototyping tool with real-time team collaboration and code inspection for developers — nearly an industry standard.
features: Dev Mode for specs and code
skills.bestFor: Practically every team building digital products.
skills.author: Figma

skills.name: Tailwind CSS
skills.overview: Tailwind CSS writes styles directly in HTML with utility classes — no hopping between CSS files. Fast, consistent interface work, and one of the most popular CSS approaches today.
skills.bestFor: Teams wanting faster styling without naming and writing classes.
skills.pricing: Open source (MIT); Tailwind UI is paid components
skills.author: Tailwind Labs

skills.name: shadcn/ui
skills.overview: shadcn/ui doesn't have you npm-install a black-box component library — it copies component source into your project (built on Radix + Tailwind) so you can change anything and aren't locked in.
features: Component source copied into your project
CLI to add components in one command
skills.bestFor: React + Tailwind teams wanting their own components, not a black box.
skills.author: shadcn

skills.name: Excalidraw
skills.overview: Excalidraw is an open-source online whiteboard with a hand-drawn style for architecture diagrams, flows and wireframes — great for quick thinking and remote collaboration, loved by engineers.
skills.bestFor: People who'd rather draw than write docs to sort out an idea.
skills.pricing: Open source (MIT); Excalidraw+ adds paid collaboration
skills.author: Excalidraw
